name: Spirit-Thread Divination
summary: Hang a pendulum over a thing and ask it one small question.
flavour: The thread swings against its own weight, and the answer arrives before the question finishes.

name: Augur’s Glance
summary: Things that would answer a divination catch at the corner of your eye.
flavour: Something in the room declines to be ordinary.

name: Sleight of Hand
summary: Locks, latches and other people’s pockets open for you.
flavour: Your fingers do something you did not instruct them to do, and the catch gives.

name: Misdirection
summary: Every eye in the room goes to the wrong place for as long as you need.
flavour: They all look left. You were never on the left.

name: Mocking Barb
summary: A jibe pitched precisely at the thing they are hiding.
flavour: You say the one sentence they have been rehearsing against, and their rehearsal falls apart.

name: Paper Mask
summary: A borrowed bearing and an unremarkable face. Nobody recalls you clearly.
flavour: You adjust nothing, and become somebody who was always meant to be standing here.

name: Stage Presence
summary: You occupy the room. Answers come out fuller than intended.
flavour: The air arranges itself around you, and they find themselves explaining.

name: Conjurer’s Reach
summary: The prop you need is in your hand, and was always in your hand.
flavour: You produce the key. It is warm, as though it has been in your pocket for hours.

name: Borrowed Face
summary: Become someone they already trust. Doors open for the face, not for you.
flavour: You put on their face, and their name comes with it, and for a moment you have to check which one you answer to.

name: Hollow Step
summary: Walk out of a room that is trying very hard to keep you.
flavour: You are not there. The interval where you were there closes behind you.

name: Read the Room
summary: Every lie in earshot announces itself.
flavour: Their words go on. Underneath them you can hear the shape of what is not being said.

name: Steady the Thread
summary: Take hold of your own spirit body and stop it shaking.
flavour: You find the loose end of yourself and wind it back in.

name: Read the Cards
summary: Perform the role in earnest — the acting method, done on purpose.
flavour: You lay them out for a stranger and tell them something true, and mean every word of it.

name: Take the Temperature
summary: Ask the street how much of it is thinking about you.
flavour: You listen past the traffic, and the city answers with a number you feel rather than hear.

name: Unmarked
summary: Shed whatever it is that makes a face worth remembering.
flavour: Somebody looks straight at you and forgets, halfway through, what they were looking at.

name: Spirit Threads
summary: Take the strings of a thing that has none, and move it.
flavour: The threads are already there. All a Marionettist does is decide to hold them.

name: Puppet Double
summary: Leave something behind that walks and talks as you did.
flavour: It is not a decoy. It is a rehearsal of you, and it does the part rather well.

name: Thread of the Hanged
summary: A knot that opens what has been tied shut for a long time.
flavour: Every lock is a knot somebody tied on purpose.

name: Exchange of Places
summary: Trade where you are for where something else is.
flavour: The world does not notice the substitution. It only notices afterwards, and by then it is polite about it.

name: Bizarre Charm
summary: Ask a question in a way that makes the truth the easiest answer.
flavour: Nothing is compelled. Everything is simply arranged so that lying is more effort.

name: Walk In The Dream
summary: Sleep where the dreaming is, and come back with your mind mended.
flavour: You wake with the taste of somebody else’s afternoon in your mouth.

name: Hour Of Miracles
summary: Make a small impossibility, and pay for it in the ordinary way.
flavour: A miracle is only a coincidence that has been asked for by name.

name: Sign Of Fortune
summary: Read the luck in a room the way other people read the weather.
flavour: It is not that you know what will happen. It is that you know which way to be standing.

name: Borrowed Miracle
summary: Take back a night’s sleep you never had.
flavour: Borrowed, not given. Something, somewhere, is keeping the account.

name: The Attendant’s Answer
summary: Ask the mysteries directly, and be answered directly.
flavour: There is no pendulum any more. There is only the question, and the fact that it is already answered.

name: The Ceremonial Door
summary: Step out of a place that has no way out of it.
flavour: You do not go through the wall. You go through the ceremony.

name: The Fool’s Hand
summary: Reach for a thing that is not in reach, in a way nothing in the world objects to.
flavour: Above the fog, a hand comes down. It is your hand, and it has been for some time.

name: Above The Fog
summary: See a thing as it is, all the way down, including the part you would rather not.
flavour: The seat at the head of the table was never a disguise. It was a vacancy, and you filled it.

name: Witness Of Yore
summary: Ask a place what it stood through, and be there while it answers.
flavour: The Scholar of Yore does not read history. History reads him in, as a witness, and the deposition is not optional.

name: The Long Record
summary: Name a thing a man did before he had decided to hide it.
flavour: Everyone is a document. Most are badly kept, and none are sealed.

name: Borrowed Epoch
summary: Stand in a moment that is over, and walk out of it somewhere else.
flavour: A door that was bricked up in 1201 is still a door, to somebody standing in 1201.
